items.title: Exclusive: Qualcomm begins job cuts; India and California among regions impacted
items.summary: Investing.com — Qualcomm has begun rolling out planned job cuts across its global operations, affecting employees in India and California, according to people familiar with the company’s plans.

items.title: Apple Just Hit $5 Trillion. Its “Biggest Competition” Is a SpaceX Phone, Says Gene Munster
items.summary: Key TakeawaysApple closed above $350 for the first time on Monday, which took its market value back above $5 trillion. Gene Munster says Apple’s biggest competition is a SpaceX phone that Elon Musk has called “utterly false,” and SpaceX is already building a nationwide 5G network with Qualcomm.

items.title: I Bonds Pay 5.51%. Why Retirees Might Still Prefer Dividend Stocks
items.summary: A Treasury-backed bond out-yields Coca-Cola and Qualcomm by a wide margin, yet retirees keep buying dividend stocks. Between lockups, state taxes, and a missing paycheck, the real math may surprise you.

items.title: Could QUALCOMM (QCOM) Be 8% Undervalued Following Its Fresh Debt Raise?
items.summary: QUALCOMM (QCOM) just raised fresh debt capital through a series of fixed income offerings, issuing callable senior unsecured notes across 2028, 2029, 2031, 2033, and 2036 maturities to fund its longer term plans. The fresh bond sale lands after a busy stretch for QUALCOMM, where the stock has swung on mixed earnings reactions, cautious revenue guidance and headlines around AI data center deals and SpaceX partnerships, even as ETF flows have flipped between buying and selling. items.title: Freedom Broker cuts Qualcomm rating as margin squeeze offsets growth upside
items.summary: Investing.com -- Freedom Broker downgraded Qualcomm (NASDAQ: QCOM) from Buy to Hold and cut its price target to $185 from $200 in a note on Tuesday, saying the chipmaker’s shift toward new growth businesses will weigh on margins longer than expected.

items.title: Qualcomm Price Prediction: Automotive Boom Could Spark a Surprise Rebound
items.summary: Qualcomm's handset business is shrinking fast, yet a quieter segment just posted a record quarter that few investors are watching. Can it outrun the earnings damage, and where does our model say the stock lands?
